name: 12903 · Plattsburgh, NY
findings: ZIP 12903 (Plattsburgh) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12903 (Plattsburgh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12903 (Plattsburgh) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
